claims.claim_text: I observed a gray four-door Honda Accord, California license plate #5AMS437, parked in the northernmost marked stall behind Ralph's Grocery.
The vehicle was parked head-in, facing east.
Both the PVS and my Body Worn Camera were activated throughout the incident.
At approximately 0112 hours, the subject started the engine.
The subject stated, "How's it going?" I responded, "It's going alright man. Can you roll down the window all the way?"
PPD Dispatch notified us that the Honda was registered to the subject. Dispatch also advised that no firearms were registered to the subject.
I told Officer Coelho that I did not know if the subject was arming himself and that I intended to use my ASP baton to break the window. Officer Coelho recommended we wait for additional units.
The first round fired by the subject struck the passenger side of the windshield of Unit #13.
The subject discharged a firearm through the driver's side door window, shattering it.
Officer Cruz reached through the broken window and recovered a Polymer80 nine-millimeter semi-automatic handgun from the subject's lap area.
I rendered the handgun safe by removing the magazine and ejecting a live cartridge from the chamber.
Due to heavy dark tint on all windows, I was unable to observe the interior.
The subject was transported to UCI Medical Center, where he was pronounced deceased at approximately 0217 hours.
Officer Vega gave the subject repeated commands in both English and Spanish.
